data.name: Full-Day Sail
data.headline: 8 Hour Private Charter
data.description: Embark on a customized sailing adventure and choose your destination. Egmont Key, Anna Maria, or Shell Key. Opt for Egmont Key to explore a historic island, home to gopher tortoises, remains of Fort Dade, and secluded beaches. Choose Anna Maria for a charming coastal town with picturesque surroundings. While Shell Key is a haven for unspoiled nature with fantastic shelling opportunities. Whichever destination you select, our experienced crew will ensure a fun-filled sailing experience.

meeting_point.address: 6800 Sunshine Drive South St. Petersburg, FL US 33705

data.cancellation_notes:
Customer Cancellation: Cancellations must be requested via call or email no less than 24hrs before trip departure for a full refund. No shows will be charged full price. 

Weather Cancellations: If your trip's departure may be impacted by weather, our captains will reach out via text or email no less than 2hrs before departure with a weather update. Should the trip be canceled, guests are entitled to a full refund.
